subject.title: FailoverError during cli-backend turn does not clear stale cliSessionIds from sessions.json, causing infinite retry loop

question: Should the open linked PR's guarded FailoverError/AbortError cleanup become the accepted fix for this issue?
rationale: The source path still needs a fix, but session-state cleanup after failed reused CLI turns is compatibility-sensitive and the active implementation is already in a PR awaiting maintainer review.

options.title: Review and land the linked cleanup
options.body: Accept the provider/session-id/error-guarded cleanup in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97895 if exact-head checks and maintainer review remain clean.

options.title: Require live restart proof first
options.body: Ask for a redacted Claude CLI plus inbound-channel restart proof before accepting the persisted-session-state mutation.

options.title: Choose a different recovery policy
options.body: Close or replace the linked PR if maintainers want a different owner boundary or recovery behavior for failed reused CLI sessions.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the provider/session-id/error-guarded cleanup in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97895 if exact-head checks and maintainer review remain clean.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the best current routing candidate from recent auto-reply runner and CLI dispatch history around the affected channel path.
